purpose: Document local registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Official SIGSantos WFS qualification completed on 13 aligned 0.001° cells and four adjacent pans using only `GEOM,lote`. All 13 raw collection member counts matched numberMatched and numberReturned. The existing adapter passed all 13 cells, fresh reads for all 171 distinct native lote IDs, exact explicit absence, full parcel footprint lookup and proposal binding. It failed forced pageSize=3 because its hardcoded `sortBy=lote` is non-unique and the provider repeated FIDs across sorted offsets. The WFS itself supports count/startIndex paging when sortBy is omitted (62/62 unique FIDs over 21 pages), but this existing adapter cannot express that contract. Runtime remains disabled pending a safe pagination/identity contract.
registryAssessment: The municipal SIGSantos portal publishes an official `santos:lotes` Polygon WFS layer. `DescribeFeatureType` reports `lote` as a string and `GEOM` as geometry, alongside additional non-requested fields. The bounded query requested only `GEOM,lote`. The native `lote` value repeats across distinct FIDs in 40 groups, although tested same-lote copies had equal geometry; it must not be used as a unique stable sort key.

privacy: Every bounded feature request selected only GEOM and native lote; no owner, address, numero, street, legal-description or credentials data were requested or retained. Full raw geometries and QA products remain under /tmp; the repository retains only three sample polygons.

forcedThreeRow.reason: Adapter hardcodes sortBy=lote; repeated native values cause overlapping FID sets across startIndex offsets.

qualification.neededAdapterContract: Support a WFS source with no sortBy (verified stable default-order count/startIndex paging) or a truly unique server-side sortable identity. Native lote is a parcel label but not unique among source rows, so it cannot be the generic adapter sort key. Preserve exact GEOM,lote selection and explicit count/member checks.
